inputs.hardLoadTimeoutMs: integration-configurable; may collapse to static fallback

NEW.effect: pre-mount internal state; no skip/failure transition

MOUNTED.effect: host mounted; synchronously resolves reduced-motion/capability/full-motion path

REDUCED_MOTION.effect: do not initialise WebGL or run 3D; choose static/existing Welcome fallback

LOADING.effect: layout reserved; semantic shell/continue path remains available

SLOW_LOAD.effect: loading may continue in background, but Continue is explicit and immediate

READY.effect: assets ready; animation may start; runtime failure remains recoverable

RUNNING.effect: full sequence; Skip remains available; runtime failure remains recoverable

FAILED.effect: capture bounded failure reason; no error dead-end

FALLBACK_STATIC.effect: static brand/orientation surface; normal shell can continue

SKIPPED.effect: stop/cancel motion work and hand off immediately

HANDOFF_READY.effect: motion ended; HTML shell is authoritative

SHELL_READY.effect: existing Welcome shell/actions are interactive; no auto-navigation

accessibility.control: ordinary DOM button/link; no canvas-only hit target
accessibility.focus: mount/load/run/complete do not steal focus; existing route focus logic remains authority
accessibility.entry_gate: animation completion is never required to reach normal product entry
accessibility.status: optional polite status; failure detail need not be exposed as technical error
accessibility.verification_limit: synthetic focus token is not browser DOM/keyboard/assistive-technology proof

layout.reservation: entry page stays full viewport for every canonical state in the synthetic contract
layout.camera: host resize updates aspect only; lens/FOV fixed
